title: Reverse a String
statement: Given a string s, return a new string with the characters in reverse order.
think: What is the task asking? Reverse the order of characters.
What is the key operation? Swap characters from both ends moving inward.
What wording signals stand out? Reverse, string, both ends.
What is the brute force idea? Build a new string from the end to the start.
What is the better/optimal idea? Convert to char array and swap with two pointers.
What are the edge cases? Empty string, one character, even/odd length.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(n) space in C# because strings are immutable.
How would I explain it in an interview? I use one pointer at each end and swap until they meet.
algorithm: Return new string from the array
interview: I would use two pointers from both ends and swap characters until the pointers meet.
ru: Ставим один указатель слева, второй справа и меняем символы местами, пока не дойдём до середины.
visualExplanation:
s = "abcd"
a b c d
^     ^
swap -> d b c a
  ^ ^
swap -> d c b a

important: Forget strings are immutable in C#
nice: Do not explain why left/right pointers fit

gaps: Nice to have: mention char[] for mutable operations
whyThisPattern: This is a Two Pointers problem because reversal naturally compares and swaps from both ends.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not HashSet, because uniqueness is irrelevant.
Not Dictionary, because no mapping or counting is needed.
